items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: I heard Symphony Sid play it and Mort Feeger, on the radio.

ctx.x: Yeah, and you weren’t even aware that it was happening.

I wasn’t aware. But I heard Symphony Sid play it and Mort Feeger, on the radio. And I thought wait, I thought maybe it was going to be played once or twice, you know, but they started playing it and they started, I couldn’t believe it. I was so grateful, because it meant travel, it meant better clubs, it meant more money. But the money wasn’t really that important to me, I mean I just loved to sing so much, and I wanted to get paid, I mean it’s not unimportant, I wanted to get paid a decent salary and I wanted to…
